CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_commercial_context()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); org uuid; pid uuid; rs text[]; result jsonb; BEGIN
 org:=public.h15_actor_organization();
 SELECT partner_id INTO pid FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=u;
 IF NOT public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(u,pid) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(role::text ORDER BY role::text) INTO rs FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=u;
 result:=jsonb_build_object('contract','C2_MULTIPROFILE_V1','actor_id',u,'tenant_id',org,
 'organization_id',org,'partner_id',pid,'commercial_owner_organization_id',org,'external_roles',rs,
 'role',CASE WHEN 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs) THEN 'parceiro_b2b' ELSE 'parceiro_b2b_tecnico' END,
 'papel',CASE WHEN 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs) THEN 'gestor' ELSE 'tecnico' END,'mode','commercial_owner',
 'manager', 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs),'technician','parceiro_b2b_tecnico'=ANY(rs),
 'producer_links_valid',platform_private.c2_producer_links(u,org),
 'profile_stamp',(SELECT updated_at FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=u),
 'link_version',(SELECT version FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=u));
 RETURN result;
END $function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$
  -- Read-only predicate. Internal staff (administrador/gestor_comercial/financeiro) of the active organization that

  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_partner IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id = auth.uid()
                    AND r.role::text IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico','cliente_produtor'))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_users pu WHERE pu.user_id = auth.uid() AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id = auth.uid()
                AND r.role::text IN ('administrador','gestor_comercial','financeiro'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa
                JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
                     AND owner.ativo IS TRUE AND owner.status = 'ativa'
                WHERE pa.id = p_partner AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id = platform_private.h15_actor_organization())

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_accounting_pending_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- While pending, only commercial review/quote, rejection or cancellation are possible: no approval,
 -- credit decision, economics seal, receivable, production, NF or delivery.
 -- INSERT: the canonical create may land in em_analise_comercial, aguardando_cotacao or (insufficient credit)
 -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito; nothing operational/financial may be set at creation.
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' AND (
     NEW.status::text NOT IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','aguardando_aprovacao_credito')
     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approved_at IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF OLD.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1'
    AND NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' THEN
  -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito may only stay as is (no hidden credit decision) or leave to cancel/reject.
  IF NOT (NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','cancelado','reprovado')
          OR (NEW.status=OLD.status AND OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito'))
     OR (OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito' AND NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao'))
     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_at OR NEW.approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_at
     -- review e1e9aa2f: no credit/financial decision field may advance by any privileged path while pending.
     OR NEW.credit_approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_by OR NEW.credit_approval_notes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approval_notes
     OR NEW.approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_by
     -- review 61b28: the canonical create (same txn, private create ticket) initializes not_required -> pending/not_required;
     -- any other change (e.g. -> approved) is a financial decision and stays denied while pending.
     OR (NEW.financial_approval_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.financial_approval_status
         AND NOT (platform_private.has_ticket('c2_external_order_create',NEW.partner_id)
                  AND OLD.financial_approval_status='not_required' AND NEW.financial_approval_status IN ('pending','not_required'))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

 AND o.id=platform_private.c2p1_internal_actor(ARRAY['administrador','financeiro','gestor_comercial']::public.app_role[]))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.guard_manual_lot_write_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
 p public.programacao_producao%ROWTYPE;
 old_manual boolean:=false;
 old_programacao uuid;
 org uuid;
BEGIN
 -- Lock old/new parents in deterministic order. An UPDATE cannot escape the
 -- manual fence by changing programacao_id to onfarm or NULL.
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN old_programacao:=OLD.programacao_id; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.programacao_producao
 WHERE id=NEW.programacao_id OR id=old_programacao
 ORDER BY id FOR SHARE;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.programacao_producao
    WHERE id=OLD.programacao_id AND ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL) INTO old_manual;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO p FROM public.programacao_producao WHERE id=NEW.programacao_id;
 IF old_manual OR p.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL OR p.id IS NULL THEN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND old_manual THEN
   org:=platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
   IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND org IS NOT NULL AND public.technical_actor_ready(auth.uid()) IS TRUE
    AND (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'producao')) IS TRUE
    AND p.id IS NOT NULL AND p.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NULL AND p.organization_id=org AND NEW.organization_id=org AND OLD.organization_id=org
    AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'status'-'updated_at') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'status'-'updated_at')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id
     WHERE o.id=p.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=org AND c.organization_id=org AND o.status::text='em_cq'
     AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL AND o.partner_order_item_id IS NULL AND o.origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'b2b')
    AND ((OLD.status::text='em_producao' AND NEW.status::text='aguardando_cq' AND p.status::text='aguardando_cq'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets WHERE txid=txid_current() AND scope='manual_cq_send_v1' AND target=NEW.id))
     OR (OLD.status::text='aguardando_cq' AND NEW.status::text IN ('aprovado','reprovado') AND p.status::text='aguardando_cq'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets WHERE txid=txid_current() AND scope='manual_cq_'||NEW.status::text||'_v1' AND target=NEW.id)
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.controle_qualidade c WHERE c.lote_id=NEW.id AND c.organization_id=org AND c.resultado::text=NEW.status::text
      AND c.responsavel='DADOS FICTICIOS SEM VALOR COMERCIAL' AND c.ph IS NOT NULL AND c.concentracao IS NOT NULL)))
   THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  END IF;

  -- No JWT/GUC/current_user/service-role escape: only the reviewed insert RPC
  -- can issue this private, target-specific ticket; it removes it after INSERT.
  org:=platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR org IS NULL OR auth.uid() IS NULL
   OR public.technical_actor_ready(auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE
   OR p.id IS NULL OR p.ordem_servico_id IS NULL OR p.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL
   OR p.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org
   OR p.produto_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.produto_id OR p.microrganismo_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.microrganismo_id
   OR p.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'aguardando' OR NEW.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'em_producao'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id
     WHERE o.id=p.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=org AND c.organization_id=org
     AND o.status::text='programada' AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL AND o.partner_order_item_id IS NULL
     AND o.origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'b2b')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets
     WHERE txid=pg_catalog.txid_current() AND scope='manual_lot_insert_v1' AND target=NEW.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MANUAL_LOT_WRITE_REQUIRES_REVIEWED_RPC' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.produto_etiqueta_root_org_v1(p_lote uuid, p_produto uuid, p_envase uuid, p_envase_item uuid, p_estoque_item uuid, p_embalagem uuid, p_entrega uuid, p_entrega_item uuid, p_cliente uuid, p_fazenda uuid, p_substitui uuid, p_substituida_por uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT l.organization_id FROM public.lotes l
  WHERE l.id = p_lote AND l.organization_id IS NOT NULL
    -- envase_item_id / entrega_item_id have no referenced table (opaque): any non-null value cannot be proven => deny.
    AND p_envase_item IS NULL AND p_entrega_item IS NULL
    -- global catalogue product: no tenant; only must match the lot's product when both are set.
    AND (p_produto IS NULL OR l.produto_id IS NULL OR l.produto_id = p_produto)
    AND (p_envase IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.envase v WHERE v.id = p_envase AND v.lote_id = l.id AND v.organization_id = l.organization_id))
    AND (p_estoque_item IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.estoque_produto s WHERE s.id = p_estoque_item AND s.lote_id = l.id
          AND (p_envase IS NULL OR s.envase_id IS NULL OR s.envase_id = p_envase)))
    AND (p_embalagem IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.estoque_embalagens m WHERE m.id = p_embalagem AND m.lote_id = l.id
          AND (p_envase IS NULL OR m.envase_id IS NULL OR m.envase_id = p_envase)
          AND (m.cliente_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes mc WHERE mc.id = m.cliente_id AND mc.organization_id = l.organization_id))))
    AND (p_entrega IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.entregas e WHERE e.id = p_entrega AND e.organization_id = l.organization_id))
    AND (p_cliente IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id = p_cliente AND c.organization_id = l.organization_id))
    AND (p_fazenda IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fazendas f WHERE f.id = p_fazenda AND f.organization_id = l.organization_id
          AND (p_cliente IS NULL OR f.cliente_id = p_cliente)))
    -- substitutions: referenced label's own immutable lot must be of the same organization (one level, direct table
    -- read inside this DEFINER helper; no policy or helper recursion).
    AND (p_substitui IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produto_etiquetas r JOIN public.lotes rl ON rl.id = r.lote_id
          WHERE r.id = p_substitui AND rl.organization_id = l.organization_id))
    AND (p_substituida_por IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produto_etiquetas r JOIN public.lotes rl ON rl.id = r.lote_id
          WHERE r.id = p_substituida_por AND rl.organization_id = l.organization_id))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.stock_envase_mutation_gate_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET lock_timeout TO '3s'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_LEVEL<>'STATEMENT' OR TG_WHEN<>'BEFORE' OR TG_OP NOT IN ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE')
 OR TG_RELID NOT IN ('public.organizations'::regclass,'public.organization_subscriptions'::regclass,'public.saas_plan_versions'::regclass,'public.saas_plan_version_features'::regclass,'public.saas_features'::regclass,'public.saas_modules'::regclass,'public.organization_feature_overrides'::regclass,'public.clientes'::regclass,'public.programacao_producao'::regclass,'public.ordens_servico'::regclass,'public.lotes'::regclass,'public.controle_qualidade'::regclass,'public.estoque_produto'::regclass) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ENVASE_GATE_CONTEXT_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- Existing upstream RPCs can prelock business rows before their first DML.
 -- Never wait here while owning those rows: reject contention atomically instead
 -- of closing the singleton/business-row deadlock cycle.
 PERFORM 1 FROM cf_user_guards_v1.state WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOCK_GATE_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE='PT503'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_visit_immutability()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Technical content is frozen for every nature and actor after submission.
  -- Official RPCs may change status; version, timestamp and PDF processing are metadata.
  IF OLD.status::text NOT IN ('rascunho', 'em_andamento') AND
    (to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY['status','version','updated_at','pdf_status']::text[])
      IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY['status','version','updated_at','pdf_status']::text[])
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'technical_record_content_locked'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514',
      HINT = 'Use the authorized adjustment workflow before editing technical content.';
  END IF;
  NEW.version := COALESCE(OLD.version, 1) + 1;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6c_entrega_ar_b2b_link()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_po public.partner_orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_settings record;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.receivable_id IS NULL
     OR NEW.partner_order_id IS NULL
     OR NEW.receivable_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.receivable_id THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_po FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id = NEW.partner_order_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  -- 1) o recebível passa a pertencer ao parceiro (entra em saldo_em_aberto)
  UPDATE public.accounts_receivable
     SET partner_id = v_po.partner_id
   WHERE id = NEW.receivable_id AND partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_po.partner_id;

  -- 2) vínculo financeiro canônico (idempotente: unique em partner_order_id)
  SELECT * INTO v_settings FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = v_po.partner_id;
  INSERT INTO public.partner_order_financial_links(
    partner_order_id, partner_id, receivable_id, financial_status, billing_trigger, created_by)
  VALUES (v_po.id, v_po.partner_id, NEW.receivable_id, 'gerado',
          COALESCE(v_settings.billing_trigger, 'entrega'), NEW.billing_generated_by)
  ON CONFLICT (partner_order_id) DO NOTHING;

  -- 3) pedido deixa de ser "comprometido não faturado"
  UPDATE public.partner_orders
     SET financial_status = 'gerado',
         receivable_generated = true,
         receivable_generated_at = COALESCE(receivable_generated_at, now()),
         receivable_generated_by = COALESCE(receivable_generated_by, NEW.billing_generated_by)
   WHERE id = v_po.id AND COALESCE(receivable_generated,false) = false;

  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_consultor_on_confirmacao_produtor()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_cliente_nome text;
BEGIN
  -- Só dispara se for um retorno técnico e o status de confirmação mudou
  IF NEW.tipo_demanda = 'retorno_tecnico' AND OLD.confirmacao_produtor IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.confirmacao_produtor THEN
    
    SELECT nome INTO v_cliente_nome FROM public.clientes WHERE id = NEW.cliente_id;

    INSERT INTO public.notificacoes_operacionais (usuario_id, tipo, titulo, mensagem, link)
    VALUES (
      NEW.consultor_atribuido,
      'confirmacao_retorno',
      CASE 
        WHEN NEW.confirmacao_produtor = 'confirmada' THEN 'Retorno confirmado pelo produtor'
        WHEN NEW.confirmacao_produtor = 'remarcacao_solicitada' THEN 'Remarcação solicitada pelo produtor'
        ELSE 'Status de retorno alterado'
      END,
      'Cliente ' || COALESCE(v_cliente_nome,'') || ' — ' || 
      CASE 
        WHEN NEW.confirmacao_produtor = 'confirmada' THEN 'confirmou a visita para ' || to_char(NEW.data_prevista_atendimento, 'DD/MM')
        WHEN NEW.confirmacao_produtor = 'remarcacao_solicitada' THEN 'pediu para remarcar a visita de ' || to_char(NEW.data_prevista_atendimento, 'DD/MM')
        ELSE 'atualizou o status'
      END,
      '/agenda-tecnica?id=' || NEW.id::text
    );
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_managers_on_simulation_sent()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_manager uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status = 'enviada_gestor'
     AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status) THEN
    FOR v_manager IN
      SELECT DISTINCT pu.user_id
      FROM public.partner_users pu
      JOIN public.user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = pu.user_id
      WHERE pu.partner_id = NEW.partner_id
        AND ur.role IN ('parceiro_b2b','administrador','gestor_comercial')
        AND pu.user_id <> NEW.created_by
    LOOP
      INSERT INTO public.notificacoes_operacionais (
        usuario_id, tipo, titulo, mensagem, link
      ) VALUES (
        v_manager,
        'simulacao_enviada',
        'Nova simulação enviada',
        COALESCE('Simulação: ' || NEW.titulo, 'Uma simulação técnica foi enviada para revisão.'),
        '/portal-parceiro/simulacoes-equipe'
      );
    END LOOP;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_block_partner_order_edit_after_op()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_locked boolean;
BEGIN
  v_locked := public.partner_order_has_production(OLD.id);
  IF NOT v_locked THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- Campos sempre permitidos
  -- status, ready_for_production, approved_by, approved_at, approval_notes,
  -- estimated_delivery_date, observacoes, updated_at, future_financial_link

  IF NEW.subtotal IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.subtotal
     OR NEW.desconto_total IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.desconto_total
     OR NEW.total IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total
     OR NEW.partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.partner_id
     OR NEW.numero IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.numero
     OR NEW.requested_delivery_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.requested_delivery_date
  THEN
    INSERT INTO public.partner_order_audit_logs (order_id, partner_id, usuario_id, acao, dados_anteriores, dados_novos)
    VALUES (OLD.id, OLD.partner_id, auth.uid(), 'edicao_bloqueada',
            to_jsonb(OLD), to_jsonb(NEW));
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Este pedido já possui Ordem de Produção vinculada e não pode mais ser alterado.';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_registro_status_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_allowed BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_user_role public.app_role;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
    -- Obter a role do usuário atual
    SELECT role INTO v_user_role FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1;

    -- Matriz de transições permitidas
    v_allowed := CASE
      -- Fluxo padrão
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'rascunho' AND NEW.status::text IN ('em_andamento', 'finalizado', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE

      -- H9-E1: visita iniciada por start_technical_visit_secure e encerrada por
      -- finish_technical_visit_secure. Estado intermediario legitimo do fluxo de campo.
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'em_andamento' AND NEW.status::text IN ('finalizado', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'finalizado' AND NEW.status::text IN ('enviado_aprovacao', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      
      -- Durante Aprovação
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'enviado_aprovacao' AND NEW.status::text IN ('aprovado', 'reprovado', 'rascunho', 'finalizado', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      
      -- Pós Aprovação
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'aprovado' AND NEW.status::text IN ('convertido_os', 'arquivado') THEN TRUE
      
      -- REABERTURA: Só administrador pode reabrir um aprovado para enviado_aprovacao
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'aprovado' AND NEW.status::text = 'enviado_aprovacao' AND v_user_role = 'administrador' THEN TRUE
      
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'convertido_os' AND NEW.status::text = 'arquivado' THEN TRUE
      WHEN OLD.status::text = 'reprovado' AND NEW.status::text = 'arquivado' THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END;

    IF NOT v_allowed THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transição inválida: não é possível mudar de "%" para "%". Conclua a etapa atual antes de avançar ou verifique suas permissões.',
        OLD.status, NEW.status
        USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
    END IF;

    -- Validações adicionais ao finalizar (VT)
    IF NEW.status::text = 'finalizado' AND OLD.status::text IN ('rascunho', 'em_andamento') THEN
      IF COALESCE(TRIM(NEW.problema_principal), '') = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Para finalizar a visita, informe o problema principal.'
          USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
      END IF;
    END IF;

    -- Log da transição com metadados estendidos
    INSERT INTO public.registros_consultor_status_log (
      registro_consultor_id, 
      status_anterior, 
      status_novo, 
      changed_by
    ) VALUES (
      NEW.id, 
      OLD.status::TEXT, 
      NEW.status::TEXT, 
      auth.uid()
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_actor_scope(_uid uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(profile_ok boolean, org_partner uuid, user_partner uuid, user_partner_count integer, partner_valid boolean, has_catalog boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH pr AS (
    SELECT o.partner_account_id
      FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = p.organization_id
     WHERE p.user_id = _uid AND p.ativo = true AND o.ativo = true AND o.status = 'ativa'
     LIMIT 1
  ), pu AS (
    SELECT count(*)::int c, min(partner_id::text)::uuid pid
      FROM public.partner_users
     WHERE user_id = _uid AND revoked_at IS NULL
  ), valid AS (
    -- Caminho fornecedor: vínculo só resolve o parceiro com a cadeia completa
    -- perfil→organização→tenant→proprietário comprovada no servidor.
    SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT c FROM pu) = 1
                 AND public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(_uid, (SELECT pid FROM pu))
                 AND EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                     FROM public.partner_users puv
                     JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = puv.partner_id
                     JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
                     JOIN public.profiles pf ON pf.user_id = puv.user_id
                     JOIN public.organizations porg ON porg.id = pf.organization_id
                    WHERE puv.user_id = _uid
                      AND puv.partner_id = (SELECT pid FROM pu)
                      AND puv.revoked_at IS NULL
                      AND (puv.valid_from IS NULL OR puv.valid_from <= now())
                      AND pf.ativo = true
                      AND porg.ativo = true AND porg.status = 'ativa'
                      AND pf.organization_id = puv.tenant_id
                      AND puv.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
                      AND pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
                      AND owner.ativo = true AND owner.status = 'ativa'
                 )
              THEN (SELECT pid FROM pu) END AS pid
  )
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr),
         -- Organização com parceiro explícito prevalece; sem ela, o vínculo autorizado
         -- validado resolve o parceiro. Se ambos existirem e divergirem, org_partner
         -- permanece o da organização e os consumidores negam por mismatch.
         COALESCE((SELECT partner_account_id FROM pr), (SELECT pid FROM valid)),
         (SELECT pid FROM valid),
         (SELECT c FROM pu),
         CASE WHEN (SELECT partner_account_id FROM pr) IS NOT NULL
              THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pr.partner_account_id
                            WHERE pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL)
              ELSE (SELECT pid FROM valid) IS NOT NULL END,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid) e WHERE e.feature_key = 'catalogo_precos');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(module_key text, feature_key text, limit_value numeric, config jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH actor AS (
    SELECT p.organization_id
    FROM public.profiles p
    JOIN public.organizations org
      ON org.id = p.organization_id
     AND org.ativo IS TRUE
    WHERE p.user_id = _uid
      AND p.ativo IS TRUE
      AND p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY p.created_at, p.organization_id
    LIMIT 1
  ), current_subscription AS (
    SELECT s.organization_id, s.plan_version_id
    FROM public.organization_subscriptions s
    JOIN actor a ON a.organization_id = s.organization_id
    JOIN public.saas_plan_versions v
      ON v.id = s.plan_version_id
     AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED'
     AND v.effective_from <= now()
     AND (v.effective_to IS NULL OR v.effective_to > now())
    WHERE s.plan_version_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        s.status = 'ACTIVE'
        OR (s.status = 'TRIAL' AND s.trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND s.trial_ends_at > now())
      )
      AND (s.cancel_at IS NULL OR s.cancel_at > now())
    ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ), candidates AS (
    SELECT f.id AS feature_id, f.module_id, f.key AS feature_key,
           vf.enabled AS base_enabled, vf.limit_value AS base_limit, vf.config AS base_config
    FROM current_subscription s
    JOIN public.saas_plan_version_features vf ON vf.plan_version_id = s.plan_version_id
    JOIN public.saas_features f ON f.id = vf.feature_id AND f.active IS TRUE
    UNION
    SELECT f.id, f.module_id, f.key, false, NULL::numeric, NULL::jsonb
    FROM current_subscription s
    JOIN public.organization_feature_overrides o ON o.organization_id = s.organization_id
    JOIN public.saas_features f ON f.id = o.feature_id AND f.active IS TRUE
    WHERE o.ended_at IS NULL
      AND o.starts_at <= now()
      AND (o.ends_at IS NULL OR o.ends_at > now())
  ), effective AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.feature_id)
      c.feature_id, c.module_id, c.feature_key,
      CASE
        WHEN o.mode = 'REVOKE' THEN false
        WHEN o.mode = 'GRANT' THEN true
        ELSE c.base_enabled
      END AS enabled,
      CASE
        WHEN o.mode = 'GRANT' THEN o.limit_value
        WHEN o.mode = 'REVOKE' THEN NULL::numeric
        ELSE c.base_limit
      END AS effective_limit,
      c.base_config AS effective_config
    FROM candidates c
    CROSS JOIN current_subscription s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT x.mode, x.limit_value
      FROM public.organization_feature_overrides x
      WHERE x.organization_id = s.organization_id
        AND x.feature_id = c.feature_id
        AND x.ended_at IS NULL
        AND x.starts_at <= now()
        AND (x.ends_at IS NULL OR x.ends_at > now())
      ORDER BY x.created_at DESC, x.id DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) o ON true
    ORDER BY c.feature_id
  )
  SELECT m.key::text, e.feature_key::text, e.effective_limit::numeric, e.effective_config
  FROM effective e
  JOIN public.saas_modules m ON m.id = e.module_id AND m.active IS TRUE
  WHERE e.enabled IS TRUE
  ORDER BY m.key, e.feature_key
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_user_access_cliente(_user_id uuid, _cliente_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF _user_id IS NULL OR _cliente_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'administrador'::app_role), false)
     OR COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'gestor_comercial'::app_role), false)
     OR COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'gestor'::app_role), false)
  THEN
    RETURN true;
  END IF;

  -- HARDENING: papéis técnicos exigem carteira ativa e vigente.
  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'tecnico_agronomo'::app_role), false)
     OR COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'consultor_tecnico'::app_role), false)
  THEN
    RETURN COALESCE(
      public.has_active_user_cliente_access(
        _user_id, _cliente_id, ARRAY['read','execute','manage']
      ), false);
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'parceiro_b2b'::app_role), false) THEN
    RETURN COALESCE((EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_clients pc
      JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.partner_id = pc.partner_id
      JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pu.partner_id
      WHERE pu.user_id = _user_id AND pc.cliente_id = _cliente_id AND pc.active = true
        AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
    )), false);
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(public.has_role(_user_id,'parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::app_role), false) THEN
    RETURN COALESCE((EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_user_clients puc
      JOIN public.partner_users pu2 ON pu2.partner_id = puc.partner_id AND pu2.user_id = puc.user_id
      JOIN public.partner_accounts pa2 ON pa2.id = puc.partner_id
      WHERE puc.user_id = _user_id AND puc.cliente_id = _cliente_id AND puc.active = true
        AND pu2.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND pa2.ativo = true AND pa2.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND pa2.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu2.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu2.tenant_id = pa2.commercial_owner_organization_id
    ) OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_technician_clients ptc
      JOIN public.partner_users pu3 ON pu3.partner_id = ptc.partner_id AND pu3.user_id = ptc.technician_user_id
      JOIN public.partner_accounts pa3 ON pa3.id = ptc.partner_id
      WHERE ptc.technician_user_id = _user_id AND ptc.cliente_id = _cliente_id AND ptc.active = true
        AND pu3.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND pa3.ativo = true AND pa3.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND pa3.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu3.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
        AND pu3.tenant_id = pa3.commercial_owner_organization_id
    )), false);
  END IF;

  RETURN COALESCE((EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_clientes uc
    WHERE uc.user_id = _user_id
      AND uc.cliente_id = _cliente_id
      AND uc.is_active = true
      AND uc.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND (uc.valid_from IS NULL OR uc.valid_from <= now())
      AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until >= now())
  )), false);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_credit_exposure(p_partner_id uuid, p_new_order_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_exclude_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_limit numeric(14,2); v_open numeric(14,2); v_overdue numeric(14,2);
  v_committed numeric(14,2); v_pending numeric(14,2);
  v_new numeric(14,2) := ROUND(COALESCE(p_new_order_amount,0),2);
  v_proj numeric(14,2); v_disp numeric(14,2); v_pct numeric;
  v_tolerance int; v_block boolean; v_action text; v_reason text;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(credit_limit,0), COALESCE(overdue_tolerance_days,0),
         COALESCE(block_if_overdue,false), COALESCE(credit_limit_action,'block')
    INTO v_limit, v_tolerance, v_block, v_action
  FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id;
  v_limit := COALESCE(v_limit,0); v_tolerance := COALESCE(v_tolerance,0);
  v_block := COALESCE(v_block,false); v_action := COALESCE(v_action,'block');

  -- (a) recebiveis em aberto do parceiro
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_open
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE');

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_overdue
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    AND ari.due_date < (current_date - v_tolerance);

  -- (b) pedidos com compromisso financeiro real e SEM recebivel gerado
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_committed
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega',
                      'confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  -- (c) H4-001: pedidos vivos ainda nao aprovados ja consomem limite.
  --     Sem isso, N pedidos em analise passavam individualmente no teste
  --     de credito e estouravam o limite ao serem aprovados.
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_pending
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('pendente','solicitado','em_analise_comercial',
                      'aguardando_aprovacao_credito','aguardando_ajuste_comercial',
                      'aguardando_itens')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  v_proj := ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending + v_new, 2);
  v_disp := GREATEST(v_limit - v_proj, 0);
  v_pct  := CASE WHEN v_limit > 0 THEN ROUND((v_proj / v_limit) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END;

  v_reason := CASE
    WHEN v_block AND v_overdue > 0 THEN 'OVERDUE_BLOCK'
    WHEN v_limit <= 0 THEN 'NO_LIMIT_DEFINED'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit AND v_action = 'approval_required' THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_APPROVAL'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BLOCK'
    ELSE 'OK' END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'partner_id', p_partner_id,
    'credit_limit', v_limit,
    'saldo_em_aberto', v_open,
    'saldo_vencido', v_overdue,
    'comprometido_nao_faturado', v_committed,
    'comprometido_pendente', v_pending,
    'novo_pedido', v_new,
    'exposicao_atual', ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending, 2),
    'exposicao_projetada', v_proj,
    'credito_disponivel', v_disp,
    'percentual_utilizado', v_pct,
    'overdue_tolerance_days', v_tolerance,
    'block_if_overdue', v_block,
    'credit_limit_action', v_action,
    'tem_vencidos', v_overdue > 0,
    'reason_code', v_reason
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_catalogo_sync_mestre_preco(p_produto_id uuid, p_microrganismo_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_litro numeric;
  v_tiers integer;
BEGIN
  IF num_nonnulls(p_produto_id, p_microrganismo_id) <> 1 THEN RETURN; END IF;

  SELECT litro, tiers INTO v_litro, v_tiers
  FROM public.fn_catalogo_litro_canonico(p_produto_id, p_microrganismo_id);

  IF COALESCE(v_tiers,0) = 0 THEN
    RETURN; -- sem apresentacao ativa: preserva fallback legado
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('arbio.catalogo_sync', 'on', true);

  IF p_produto_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF v_tiers = 1 AND COALESCE(v_litro,0) > 0 THEN
      UPDATE public.produtos p
         SET valor_litro_brl = v_litro,
             valor_dose_brl  = round(v_litro / 10.0, 2),
             valor_ha_brl    = CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.dose_ml_ha,0) > 0
                                    THEN round(v_litro * (p.dose_ml_ha / 1000.0), 2) END
       WHERE p.id = p_produto_id
         AND (p.valor_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM v_litro
              OR p.valor_dose_brl IS DISTINCT FROM round(v_litro / 10.0, 2));
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.produtos p
         SET valor_litro_brl = NULL, valor_dose_brl = NULL, valor_ha_brl = NULL
       WHERE p.id = p_produto_id
         AND (p.valor_litro_brl IS NOT NULL OR p.valor_dose_brl IS NOT NULL OR p.valor_ha_brl IS NOT NULL);
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF v_tiers = 1 AND COALESCE(v_litro,0) > 0 THEN
      UPDATE public.microrganismos m
         SET valor_litro_brl = v_litro,
             valor_dose_brl  = round(v_litro / 10.0, 2)
       WHERE m.id = p_microrganismo_id
         AND (m.valor_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM v_litro
              OR m.valor_dose_brl IS DISTINCT FROM round(v_litro / 10.0, 2));
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.microrganismos m
         SET valor_litro_brl = NULL, valor_dose_brl = NULL
       WHERE m.id = p_microrganismo_id
         AND (m.valor_litro_brl IS NOT NULL OR m.valor_dose_brl IS NOT NULL);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('arbio.catalogo_sync', 'off', true);
END
$function$

    ultima_compra = EXCLUDED.ultima_compra,
    dias_sem_compra = EXCLUDED.dias_sem_compra,
    pedidos_30d = EXCLUDED.pedidos_30d,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_requirement_resolve(p_sales_channel text, p_operation_type text, p_uf text, p_scope_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_scope_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_ref_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_ex record; v_pol record;
BEGIN
  IF p_scope_type IS NOT NULL AND p_scope_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO v_ex FROM public.fiscal_requirement_exemptions
     WHERE active AND scope_type = p_scope_type AND scope_id = p_scope_id LIMIT 1;
    IF FOUND THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('required', false, 'status','EXEMPT', 'source','exemption',
        'exemption_id', v_ex.id, 'motivo', v_ex.motivo, 'approved_by', v_ex.approved_by);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_pol FROM public.fiscal_operation_policies
   WHERE active AND sales_channel = p_sales_channel AND operation_type = p_operation_type
     AND (uf IS NULL OR uf = p_uf)
     AND valid_from <= p_ref_date AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= p_ref_date)
   ORDER BY (uf IS NOT NULL) DESC, valid_from DESC LIMIT 1;

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('required', v_pol.requires_invoice,
      'status', CASE WHEN v_pol.requires_invoice THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_REQUIRED' END,
      'source','policy','policy_id', v_pol.id, 'document_model', v_pol.document_model);
  END IF;

  -- Fail-closed: nunca assume NOT_REQUIRED em silêncio
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('required', true, 'status','PENDING_PARAMETRIZATION',
    'source','pending_parametrization', 'policy_id', NULL,
    'motivo','Nenhuma política fiscal cadastrada para o canal/operação/UF — parametrização contábil pendente');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.h15_user_organization(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT p.organization_id
  FROM public.profiles p
  JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = p.organization_id AND o.ativo IS TRUE
  WHERE p.user_id = p_user AND p.ativo IS TRUE;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_technical_visit_editable_status(p_status text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT p_status IS NOT NULL
     AND p_status IN ('rascunho', 'em_andamento', 'devolvido_correcao');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.saas_has_feature(_feature_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(auth.uid()) e
    WHERE e.feature_key = _feature_key
  )
$function$
